```{python}
#| label: fig-die-per-wafer
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Number of dice per wafer as a function of the die size, for the standard wafer diameters (2 mm edge exclusion assumed)."

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

A = np.linspace(5, 100, 200)   # die size in mm^2

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))
for d, style, label in [(146, ':', '150 mm wafer'),
                        (196, '--', '200 mm wafer'),
                        (296, '-', '300 mm wafer')]:
    N = d * np.pi * (d / (4 * A) - 1 / np.sqrt(2 * A))
    ax.semilogy(A, N, style, color='tab:blue', lw=2, label=label)

ax.set_xlabel('Die size $A$ (mm²)')
ax.set_ylabel('Dice per wafer $N$')
ax.set_ylim(100, 100000)
ax.grid(True, which='both', alpha=0.3)
ax.legend(fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
